license.privacyBody:
The demo hosted at roy.bz does not collect personal information, does not track users, and does not use cookies. This is a fun technical experiment intended for people to explore, learn from, and optionally copy or fork.

This demo also uses external services (for example, public currency conversion APIs) that are subject to their own privacy policies and availability.

By using this demo or the code, you agree that you are responsible for your own use, and the author is not liable for any outcomes.
